sources.snippet: Featured BananaMind-2-Pro-Preview Preview checkpoint Base model Community License 1.0 The first public checkpoint of BananaMind 2 Pro, exported after 96,000 optimizer steps and 51,904,512,000 training tokens of an ongoing 100B-token pretraining run. Its scores describe this exact checkpoint and are not final BananaMind 2 Pro results.

sources.title: README.md · BananaMind/BananaMind-2-Pro at main
sources.snippet: BananaMind-2-Pro is a 138,971,520-parameter decoder-only base language model trained from scratch by BananaMind. The completed pretraining run processed 99,999,449,088 tokens —the scheduled realization of a 100B-token curriculum—over 184,954 optimizer steps.
